description: Industry momentum drives a large portion of stock momentum; removing industry component isolates firm-specific momentum which is more likely to reflect fundamental improvement rather than sector rotation, so going long top 50 and short bottom 50 by 126-day momentum (skip 21) after demeaning by industry (using 48 Fama-French industries approximated by rank within quantiles) should yield positive forward Sharpe; falsified if forward Sharpe is not positive.
title: Industry-Neutral Momentum · 126d skip 21 · Top 1000 · Long-Short
